intro: Gerard Tiller is a thirsty human farmhand working outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Tending the vineyards under the warm sun, he is always eager to trade a crisp, shiny red apple to any traveler willing to spare a skin of refreshing spring water.

p: Gerard Tiller spends his days toiling in the fields and tending the grounds outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards. Located just south of Goldshire, the vineyard produces some of Elwynn's best-known grapes, but keeping the harvest running is hard labor. Tiller is constantly parched from his chores, making him quick to barter with passing adventurers. If someone offers him a fresh skin of cool spring water, he happily repays the courtesy with fresh, shiny red apples gathered straight from the local orchards.
